KEEP the meaning but GENERALISE any ethnic/cultural specific: write "her mother tongue" or "her community's language and culture" rather than naming a language (e.g. Tamil, Mandarin/Chinese), and "a teacher who inspired her" rather than "her Tamil teacher". Where a fact is missing, leave it out rather than guess. Do NOT state any monetary amount or recommended sum — that figure is shown separately to the reader; instead describe concretely and factually what the support would help the student with. - Some fields are marked "not established — do not claim" — NOT verified. Do not assert them; omit them.

Never round up or imply a uniform top grade. If a merit score is given, you may cite it.
